# Lesson 1 The harms of e-waste

# **E-stuff We Own**

| Phone Chargers Baterries  Storage Tv Remote Speakers HDMI cord Powercables Microwave Fridge Washing Machine EZ Bake Over Video Game Console (Switch) Controllers Ethernet Cable Game disc/cartridges Computer/laptop Chargers Monitor Keyboard/mouse Cables etc |
| :---- |

Question: Where does it all go when we’re done with it?

[The Story of Electronics](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sW_7i6T_H78)

**Upside of e-stuff:**  

- It helps us learn  
- It helps us communicate easily  
- It helps us have fun  
- It helps us get stuff done faster. 

**Downsides of e-stuff:**

- **Hard to recycle**  
- **Deadly toxics spreading easily**  
- **Expensive to make**   
- **Companies don’t want to make it last (easy money)**

Agbogbloshie, Ghana

How does Canada’s e-waste end up here?  
[This video is about the illegal e-waste shipping business to Guiyu China](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SCGEvOmKo98), which was the former largest e-waste dump in the world.

Today, China has made efforts to improve the situation in Guiyu, but the illegal dumping has just moved to other countries, like Ghana (see above photos).
